description: This header file declares factory classes and functions for creating resource grids, resource grid mappers, PRACH buffers, and interpolators within the ocudu namespace, primarily used for 5G NR physical layer support.

classes.name: resource_grid_factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating resource grid instances.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper_factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating resource grid mappers.

methods.name: create_resource_grid_factory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a resource grid factory.

methods.name: create_generic_resource_grid_pool
methods.description: Creates a resource grid pool that repeats resource grids every number of requests equal to the size of the input vector.

methods.name: create_asynchronous_resource_grid_pool
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous resource grid pool with expiry timeout, using a task executor.

methods.name: create_resource_grid_mapper_factory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a resource grid mapper factory, given a precoder factory.

methods.name: create_prach_buffer_long
methods.description: Creates a long PRACH sequence buffer for up to 4 OFDM symbols.

methods.name: create_prach_buffer_short
methods.description: Creates a short PRACH sequence buffer for a specified number of time and frequency domain occasions.
